integrity: Signed integer discrete-Morse boundary matrices and complete face-poset acyclicity are reproduced by bundled standard-library checker; independent mod-two boundaries corroborate only the corresponding homology.
scientific_limitations: Only n=3,4,5,6; a finite exact homotopy classification with no extrapolation to infinite families. Some broad prior sources were only abstract-accessible and unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Two-matching homotopy of the first four nondegenerate Möbius ladders
